_readme: BATTLEFIELD 6 — aircraft (jet / helicopter), matching the game's DEFAULT
Aircraft controller scheme. Because the HOTAS gives every axis its own
control, you do NOT need the in-game 'Alternate' preset — keep Default.
BF6 default aircraft scheme: left stick = yaw + throttle, right stick =
pitch + roll (push forward = nose down), RT = fire, LT = zoom,
LS click = afterburner, RS click = camera, Y = switch weapon,
X = reload / hold to exit, A = switch seat, d-pad = equipment slots
So here: THROTTLE LEVER -> left stick Y (up = throttle up). TWIST ->
left stick X (yaw). Main stick -> right stick (X = roll, Y = pitch,
push forward = nose down). Trigger = fire (RT). Pinkie = zoom (LT).
I = afterburner (LS). A head = camera (RS). C head = switch weapon (Y).
B head = reload / hold to exit (X). D = switch seat (A). Thumb FIRE =
B. POV hat = equipment slots. T1 = pause menu, T3 = scoreboard.
